categories.name: Traps
categories.description: Questions related to various traps in the movies.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: In the Angel Trap, Detective Allison Kerry wakes to find herself suspended in the air by a device hooked into her ribcage. To escape, she must retrieve the key to the device's padlock from a glass jar filled with ____.

In the Shotgun Carousel, six insurance agents sat strapped to a merry-go-round in front of a loaded shotgun while their employer, William Easton, had to decide who to spare as he could not afford to insure them all. How many of these agents had their life insurance policies approved?
In the Water Cube Trap, Special Agent Peter Strahm's head was stuck inside a glass box rapidly filling with water with no discernible way out. How did he manage to survive this trap?
questions.answer: He gave himself a tracheotomy using a pen in his pocket

questions.question: In the Horsepower Trap, Evan tried so hard and got so far, but in the end it didn't even matter as he and his skinhead buddies all became roadkill. How many people in total died in this trap?
The Reverse Bear Trap has been used to test three different people, but only one person has succumbed to it. Who was the unlucky victim?
questions.endnote: Amanda and Hoffman managed to survive theirs

questions.question: What is Jigsaw's real name?

categories.name: Legacy
categories.description: Questions related to the Saw franchise as a whole.

questions.question: How many feature-length movies have been released as of 2026?
questions.endnote: I, II, III, IV, V, VI, 3D, Jigsaw, Spiral, X

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Many of the Saw movie releases were accompanied by an event where participants could donate ____ in exchange for a free ticket to see the film.
questions.endnote: The Saw Blood Drive was used to promote all of the Saw movies except 3D and Spiral. All blood went to the American Red Cross.

questions.question: Two video games set in the Saw universe were released on which two video game consoles?
questions.endnote: Saw: The Video Game (2009), Saw II: Flesh & Blood (2010)

questions.question: Saw - The Ride is a rollercoaster that opened in Thorpe Park in 2009 and still operates to this day. Which country is the park based in?
Scream Queens was a two season competition reality show that awarded its winners with cameo roles in which two Saw entries?
questions.endnote:
Season 1 winner Tanedra Howard portrayed Simone Bethson (Pound of Flesh Trap).
Season 2 winner Gabby West portrayed Kara (Horsepower Trap).
